sentences.text:
The Applicant has approached this Court, see
 anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.274/2025 registered
 with Gandhi Chowk Police Station, District Latur for the offences
 punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 of Bharatiya Nyaya
 Sanhita, 2023 and Section 59 of the Foods Safety and Standards Act,
 2006.
2.  As per the First Information Report, the police authorities  conducted a raid on the shop licensed in the name of the father of  the present Applicant.
The contraband, i.e., scented tobacco and pan  masala worth Rs.5,860/-, was seized from the shop and has been  sent to the Chemical Analyzer for obtaining its report.

3. The submission of the Counsel for the Applicant submits that  2 929.ABA-1525-2025.doc the shop is being run by Jakiyoddin Sayyad in whose name the license is issued under the Shop Act and the Applicant is doing a private business and has no share or interest in the running of the shop.
He therefore submits that merely because the Applicant is the son of the licensee, he is being repeatedly dragged into various offences under the Shop Act.

He further submits that as the Sameer Jakiyyoddin Sayyad vs The Superintendent Of Police And ... on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170975708/
1 contraband is already seized nothing remains to be recovered at the instance of the Applicant and hence the custodial interrogation may not be necessary.
4.

sentences.text:
As against this, the learned APP submits that the offences are serious in nature as Section 328 IPC is attracted in the present case,
there are criminal antecedents against the present Applicant, wherein the Applicant was prosecuted for identical offences under Sections 328 and relevant Sections of IPC as well as the Food Safety and Standards Act.
5. The Counsel for the Applicant submits that the Applicant though was earlier also implicated in identical offences, this Court has granted him bail.
6. I have gone through the investigation papers made available by the learned APP.
After going through the record, I could see that the present Applicant happens to be the son of the licensee of the shop owner Mr. Jakiyyoddin Sayyad.
The amount of contraband seized from the premises is said to be Rs.5000/-, however the same is  3 929.ABA-1525-2025.doc already seized and sent to the Chemical Analyzer for obtaining its report.
Upon instructions, the learned APP informs that the CA report is yet to be received.
I am therefore of the view that the custodial interrogation of the present Applicant may not be necessary.
Although the Applicant appears to have violated the earlier conditions imposed by this Court in BA No.1302/2024, the prosecution could have very well filed an application for cancellation of bail.
Upon instructions, the learned APP submits that there are no instructions whether the prosecution has filed any application for cancellation of bail of present Applicant in Crime No.274/2024.
In my view, therefore, the Applicant can be protected.

Hence the following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of arrest of the Applicant - Sameer Jakiyyoddin Sayyad, be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands) with one solvent surety in the like amount, in connection with Crime No.274/2025 registered with Gandhi Chowk Police Station,
District Latur, on the following conditions :
(a) The Applicant is directed to attend the concerned police station and report to the Investigating Officer between 11:00 a.m. to 01:00 p.m. on every Monday, and as and when called, until the filing of the charge-sheet.
